Warm waves moved around the wooden wharf while Morgan watched a wide-winged gull above the water. Down
below, a workman moved an enormous brown box from a wagon. “Wow,” whispered Mae, who had never seen
the old warehouse open. Windows glowed along the upper wall. Someone was making room for a weekend
exhibition of maps, models, and photographs. Morgan wondered how many journeys had begun beside those
doors. Mae wondered whether the enormous box held a model boat. Both questions seemed worth keeping,
even though neither could be answered from the wharf. Warm waves moved around the wooden wharf while
